purpose: Server OpenSearch Hybrid application index built solely from the formal current 926710-product catalog and formal current Item-vector manifest. It is separate from Faiss item recall.

schema_policy.category_policy: Every indexed document is assigned exactly one leaf Category Card by trusted source category or a confident, unambiguous existing Item-vector match; weak or ambiguous vectors use the general fallback Card. Lexical rules are forbidden.
schema_policy.raw_locale_policy: source_locale_raw is source metadata and is never treated as universal item language.
schema_policy.serving: manual server operation only; the supplied build command starts OpenSearch only for its work and stops it before exit
